title: Yes, im rich sir
description: Looks like your the richest player!
body:
Yes, im rich sir

Thats something you need to tell your friends after useing this rp!

Beef item → Nether Star (purple name like real Nether Star)

Copper Shovel → Mace

Wooden Shovel → Lava Chicken Music Disc (gold name like real discs)

Stone Shovel → Trident (aqua name like real tridents)

Amethyst Shard → Ominous Key (dark purple like the real key)
